newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian interbank rates steady on high supply.
newsitem.headline: Croatian interbank rates steady on high supply.

text.p: Croatian interbank rates remained steady in Thursday morning's brisker trade characterised by higher demand for kuna funds and good supply, dealers said.
"The high demand for kuna funds was fully met by the money on offer," a dealer told Reuters.
Trade totalled 22.6 million kuna, most of it being call money at an unchanged rate of 10.5 percent and the rest short- term borrowings granted at between 13 and 16 percent.
Wednesday's overnight trade totalled 2.5 million kuna with one bank borrowing money to square its position. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
